name: youtube-transcript
description: This is a Streamlit-based web application that allows users to extract transcripts from YouTube videos and refine them using Google's Gemini AI. The app fetches the transcript, corrects errors in grammar, spelling, and punctuation, and improves readability while maintaining the original meaning of the video content.

features: Extracts transcript from YouTube videos using the YouTube Transcript API.
Uses Google Gemini AI to refine the transcript for better readability and clarity.
Provides both the original and refined transcripts for comparison.
Simple, user-friendly interface built with Streamlit.
